transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’ve come because I’m starting to arrange my whole house around not seeing spiders. I put off doing laundry because it means going into the basement, I avoid the garden shed, and I’ve even started paying people to do small jobs that I know I could do myself, just because I can’t make myself go into those spaces.
Do you find yourself avoiding other things or situations besides spiders, or is this mainly about spiders?

It’s mainly spiders. I mean, the avoiding is really around places where I think I might see one—like the basement with the laundry or the garden shed. I’ve even paid people to do little jobs I could do myself because I just can’t make myself go into those spaces.
